title: "DtMF" Reaches 60 Weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — Extends Its Own All-Time Record
detail: Bad Bunny's 'DtMF,' the title track from *Debí Tirar Más Fotos*, logs its 60th consecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart (chart dated May 23, 2026) — extending the all-time record it first broke in late April 2026 when it surpassed Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's 'Despacito' feat. Justin Bieber (56 weeks, 2017). The milestone progression: 'DtMF' hit No. 1 on January 25, 2025, just 11 days after the album's release; broke Daddy Yankee's own record on the chart dated May 2, 2026 (week 57); crossed 59 weeks on chart dated May 16, 2026; and now reaches 60 consecutive weeks atop Latin music's premier singles chart. The 60-week mark exceeds the record by more than three months of uninterrupted chart dominance. Wikipedia's List of Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart achievements and milestones now cites 60 weeks as a confirmed milestone for 'DtMF.' The record reflects the unprecedented cultural staying power of *Debí Tirar Más Fotos* — an album built on Puerto Rican plena, bomba, jíbaro, and salsa sounds that became a global crossover through the 2026 Super Bowl, Grammy AOTY win, and Spotify's most-streamed album of 2025. The 60th week arrives as Bad Bunny completes his two-night Barcelona stadium run and begins the Lisbon-Madrid leg of the DtMF World Tour.
